# Pre-COVID and Post-COVID Exploratory Data Analysis

# Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "here", "scales")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Install required packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(scales)

set.seed(415)
```

## Plot Colors and Theme

```{r descriptive-01}
pre_color <- "#377EB8"
post_color <- "#E69F00"

phq_color <- "#377EB8"
gad_color <- "#E69F00"

gender_colors <- c(
  "Men" = "#377EB8",
  "Women" = "#E69F00"
)

period_colors <- c(
  "2017-2018 Pre-COVID" = "#377EB8",
  "2022-2023 Post-COVID" = "#E69F00"
)

measure_colors <- c(
  "PHQ" = "#377EB8",
  "GAD" = "#E69F00"
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
```

# Load Data

```{r load-data}
project_root <- here::here()

pre_path <- file.path(project_root, "data", "processed", "pre_covid_clean.csv")
post_path <- file.path(project_root, "data", "processed", "post_covid_clean.csv")

if (!file.exists(pre_path) || !file.exists(post_path)) {
  stop(
    "Missing processed data files. Open the project's .Rproj file first. ",
    "Project root: ", project_root, ". ",
    "Expected: data/processed/pre_covid_clean.csv and ",
    "data/processed/post_covid_clean.csv"
  )
}

pre_covid <- readr::read_csv(pre_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
post_covid <- readr::read_csv(post_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

variables_used <- c(
  "PHQ", "GAD", "gender", "field", "race.2", "yr_sch.2", "fincur.2", "age"
)

for (period_name in c("pre_covid", "post_covid")) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(variables_used, names(get(period_name)))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(period_name, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```

# Make Variables Consistent

```{r descriptive-02}
post_covid <- post_covid %>%
  mutate(
    field = case_when(
      as.character(field) == "STEM" ~ "STEM",
      as.character(field) %in% c("NotSTEM", "Non-STEM") ~ "Non-STEM",
      TRUE ~ as.character(field)
    ),
    gender = as.character(gender),
    field = as.character(field),
    race.2 = as.character(race.2),
    yr_sch.2 = as.character(yr_sch.2),
    fincur.2 = as.numeric(fincur.2),
    age = as.numeric(age)
  )

pre_covid <- pre_covid %>%
  mutate(
    gender = as.character(gender),
    field = as.character(field),
    race.2 = as.character(race.2),
    yr_sch.2 = as.character(yr_sch.2),
    fincur.2 = as.numeric(fincur.2),
    age = as.numeric(age)
  )

pre_covid$gender <- factor(
  pre_covid$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

post_covid$gender <- factor(
  post_covid$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

pre_covid$field <- factor(
  pre_covid$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

post_covid$field <- factor(
  post_covid$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

race_levels <- c(
  "White",
  "Asian",
  "Black",
  "Hispanic",
  "Middle Eastern"
)

pre_covid$race.2 <- factor(
  pre_covid$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

post_covid$race.2 <- factor(
  post_covid$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

year_levels <- c(
  "firstyear",
  "secondyear",
  "thirdyear",
  "fourthyear+"
)

pre_covid$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  pre_covid$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)

post_covid$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  post_covid$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)
```

```{r descriptive-03}
dim(pre_covid)
```

```{r descriptive-04}

```

```{r descriptive-05}
variable_check <- data.frame(
  Variable = variables_used,
  Pre_COVID = variables_used %in% names(pre_covid),
  Post_COVID = variables_used %in% names(post_covid)
)

knitr::kable(
```

# 2017-2018 Pre-COVID EDA

## Dataset Overview

```{r descriptive-06}
dim(pre_covid)
```

```{r descriptive-07}
glimpse(pre_covid)
```

## Missing Values

```{r descriptive-08}
pre_missing <- data.frame(
  Variable = variables_used,
  Missing = sapply(
    pre_covid[, variables_used],
    function(x) sum(is.na(x))
  ),
  Percent_Missing = sapply(
    pre_covid[, variables_used],
    function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100
  )
)

pre_missing$Percent_Missing <- round(
  pre_missing$Percent_Missing,
  2
)

knitr::kable(
  pre_missing,
  caption = "Missing Data: 2017-2018"
)
```

## Depression and Anxiety Scores

```{r descriptive-09}
summary(pre_covid$PHQ)
```

```{r descriptive-10}
summary(pre_covid$GAD)
```

```{r descriptive-11}
ggplot(pre_covid, aes(x = PHQ)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1/9,
    fill = phq_color,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Depression Scores: 2017-2018",
    x = "Depression score (PHQ-9)",
    y = "Students"
  )
```


```{r descriptive-12}
ggplot(pre_covid, aes(x = GAD)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1/7,
    fill = gad_color,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Anxiety Scores: 2017-2018",
    x = "Anxiety score (GAD-7)",
    y = "Students"
  )
```


## Gender Distribution

```{r descriptive-13}
ggplot(
  filter(pre_covid, !is.na(gender)),
  aes(x = gender, fill = gender)
) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gender_colors) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Gender Distribution: 2017-2018",
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Students"
  )
```

## Mental Health by Gender

```{r descriptive-19}
pre_gender_scores <- pre_covid %>%
  select(gender, PHQ, GAD) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(PHQ, GAD),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Score"
  )

ggplot(
  filter(
    pre_gender_scores,
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(Score)
  ),
  aes(
    x = gender,
    y = Score,
    fill = gender
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Measure, labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(c(PHQ = "Depression (PHQ-9)", GAD = "Anxiety (GAD-7)"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gender_colors) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Mental Health Scores by Gender: 2017-2018",
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Score"
  )
```

## Depression and Anxiety Relationship

```{r descriptive-24}
pre_correlation <- cor(
  pre_covid$PHQ,
  pre_covid$GAD,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

pre_correlation
```

```{r descriptive-25}
ggplot(
  pre_covid,
  aes(x = PHQ, y = GAD)
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.08,
    color = pre_color
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Depression and Anxiety: 2017-2018",
    x = "Depression score (PHQ-9)",
    y = "Anxiety score (GAD-7)"
  )
```

# EDA Conclusions


# Paper Figures and Tables


```{r final_paper_export_setup}
final_paper_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs", "final_paper")
figure_dir <- file.path(final_paper_dir, "figures")
table_dir <- file.path(final_paper_dir, "tables")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_paper_figure <- function(plot, filename, width = 8, height = 5) {
  for (extension in c("png", "pdf")) {
    path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(filename, ".", extension))
    tryCatch(
      ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
                      dpi = 300, bg = "white"),
      error = function(e) message("Figure not saved: ", path)
    )
  }
}

save_paper_table <- function(tab, filename, digits = 4) {
  csv_path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".csv"))
  html_path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".html"))
  tryCatch(
    utils::write.csv(tab, csv_path, row.names = FALSE, na = ""),
    error = function(e) message("Table CSV not saved (file in use or folder blocked): ", csv_path)
  )
  tryCatch(
    writeLines(as.character(knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", digits = digits)), html_path),
    error = function(e) message("Table HTML not saved (file in use or folder blocked): ", html_path)
  )
  invisible(tab)
}
```

## Average Scores

```{r final_paper_mean_plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
mean_plot_input <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(pre_covid, Period = "2017-2018"),
  dplyr::mutate(post_covid, Period = "2022-2023")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(Period, PHQ, GAD) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(PHQ, GAD), names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Score") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Period, Outcome) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(N = sum(!is.na(Score)), Mean = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
                   SD = sd(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SE = SD / sqrt(N),
                CI_Lower = Mean - stats::qt(0.975, N - 1) * SE,
                CI_Upper = Mean + stats::qt(0.975, N - 1) * SE,
                Period = factor(Period, levels = c("2017-2018", "2022-2023")))

descriptive_table <- mean_plot_input %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Outcome = dplyr::recode(Outcome, PHQ = "Depression", GAD = "Anxiety"),
    `Survey Period` = as.character(Period),
    N = N,
    Mean = round(Mean, 4),
    SD = round(SD, 4),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("(%.4f, %.4f)", CI_Lower, CI_Upper)
  )
save_paper_table(descriptive_table, "table_01_descriptive_means_and_ci")
knitr::kable(descriptive_table, caption = "Average Scores")
```
